observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 199» (L24) in the left margin; the locator is printed without the point after the number.
body L6: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «132,6, pro interiectos l. interiectis.»; the printed «interiectos» is kept.
body L9: the letter of the reference (a) is bold italic.
body L7: a speck stands after «sphaerae» at the height of the tops of the letters; it is not a sign.
body L19, L20: specks stand over the u of «duabus» (L19) and before «medio» (L20); they are not accents.
body L29, L30: the dot of the i of «in» after «eius» (L29) is printed as a large blot; a speck stands over the c of «rectas» (L30); it is not an accent.
body L32: the o of «totius» is printed broken, open at the left.

notes_left L7-L8: the Arabic words are «في الاقاليم», the reading of the codex, and «وفي الاقاليم», Nallino's reading, divided between the lines after «وفي»; the dots of the yā’ are printed as one stroke.
body L5: the r of «descripsimus» is printed broken.
notes_left L8: a speck stands over the n of «nullum»; it is not a sign.
notes_right L2: a speck stands after «27-29.»; it is not a sign.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
